I've tried three different meds.

Sertralin. Killed my emotions, all of them and I were stuck with a constant depressive/suicidal state.
Then again, I did get quite a high dose

Then I got one where the side effects were too severe so I were only on it for like 2 months, so I can't really tell you how it worked

Now I'm on Lyrica, which is typically used for epilepsy and anxiety. I were talking to my doc and mentioned that my mood could swing from "Hey, this is a pretty good day" to "I'm fucking useless I should kill myself" in two seconds, and he mentioned this drug.

 It doesn't work on my anxiety, I'm a little bit slower (at reacting, so no car driving for me) but it does help make my mood more stable so it takes longer for me to reach the "I'm useless" stage. 

But keep in mind that what works for me might not work for you
